findings.test: script/check_website.py: privacy notice discloses every third-party script
findings.human_action: Confirm the wording matches your PilotFox configuration (e.g. whether visitor IDs are stored in localStorage) and whether you need a consent banner for EU visitors.
findings.title: Website privacy notice says 'no cookies or trackers' while loading PilotFox analytics
findings.description: The #privacy modal claimed the website uses no trackers and the app/site collect no analytics, but index.html loads the PilotFox analytics script, which records page views, clicks and outbound links.
findings.impact: Visitors are told they aren't tracked when they are; a transparency problem under GDPR/ePrivacy and for App Store review, which links to this policy.
findings.remediation: Privacy notice now names PilotFox and what it counts; the 'collects nothing' line is scoped to the app.

findings.test: YAML parse; same code as before
findings.title: Release workflow runs tag-pinned third-party actions with signing secrets in job env
findings.description: Developer ID certificate, its password and notarization credentials are exposed to every step through job-level env, and actions were referenced by mutable tags (softprops/action-gh-release@v2 etc.).
findings.impact: If an action's tag were moved or hijacked, the new code would run with the signing certificate and could sign malware as MacKitty.
findings.remediation: Pinned all four actions to the commit SHAs their tags point to today.

findings.test: script/website_smoke_test.js: no CSP violations, demo works; analytics beacons verified
findings.title: No Content-Security-Policy, HSTS or clickjacking protection
findings.description: Cloudflare Pages served only its defaults (nosniff, referrer-policy).
findings.impact: No defence-in-depth against injected scripts (e.g. a compromised third-party script origin), framing/clickjacking, or protocol downgrade.
findings.remediation: Added website/_headers: CSP (self + pilotfox.app), HSTS, X-Frame-Options/frame-ancestors, Permissions-Policy, COOP.

findings.title: Soft 404s: every unknown URL returns the homepage with HTTP 200
findings.description: Without 404.html Cloudflare Pages runs in SPA mode; /anything, /favicon.ico, /llms-full.txt and the deleted /privacy.html and /terms.html all returned the homepage with 200.
findings.impact: Search engines see duplicate soft-404 pages; old legal URLs no longer opened the policy.
findings.remediation: Added noindex 404.html and _redirects (legal URLs → #privacy/#terms modals, /favicon.ico → favicon).

findings.test: script/check_website.py: no image > 200 KB; screenshots identical
findings.title: 853 KB logo loaded for 22–54px icons
findings.description: Five tags and the apple-touch-icon used the 1024x1024 logo.png.
findings.impact: ~850 KB extra on first load, hurting LCP on mobile.
findings.remediation: 256px logo (56 KB), 180px apple-touch-icon, explicit width/height, lazy footer icon.

findings.title: JSON-LD WebSite.publisher references an undefined @id
findings.description: @id https://geeksdesigns.com/#organization was referenced but never defined.
findings.impact: Parsers can't resolve the publisher entity.
findings.remediation: Added the Organization node; app also references it; added @id/url/downloadUrl.

findings.title: Title (72 chars) and description (178 chars) truncated in results
findings.impact: 'Mac Cleaner' cut from the title in results.

findings.title: llms.txt without Markdown links; no llms-full.txt
findings.description: Links were plain text; /llms-full.txt returned the homepage.
findings.impact: AI tools following llmstxt.org found no links or full text.
findings.remediation: Rewrote llms.txt in llmstxt.org format; added llms-full.txt.

findings.human_action: After deploying, re-scrape: Facebook Sharing Debugger, LinkedIn Post Inspector, paste into the X composer.
findings.title: Link-preview image is a 1024x1024, 853 KB square icon without alt
findings.impact: Cropped large cards; WhatsApp may drop images over ~300 KB.
findings.remediation: 1200x630, 40 KB og-image.jpg with width/height/type/alt and twitter:image:alt.

findings.title: No AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md; .env vars undocumented
findings.description: No agent instructions; package_and_notarize_local.sh reads APPLE_ID/APPLE_TEAM_ID/APPLE_APP_SPECIFIC_PASSWORD with no .env.example.
findings.impact: Agents and contributors miss the CSP/privacy/SEO conventions and the app safety rules.
findings.remediation: Added AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md (@AGENTS.md), .env.example, README website section.
